provenance.method: Real Pack helpers: both-source lead route; four accepted three-step plans with utterances at the 192-byte double-JSON limit; then a fresh hatch planning opportunity for each Role.

mira.objective: Recover the authentic ledger, return to the Atrium, and extract before turn 16 ends. Mira wants every claim grounded in visible evidence.
